claims.text: Machine-learning algorithms can predict phase stability in high-entropy alloys.
Machine-learning algorithms can predict thermodynamic properties of high-entropy alloys.
The proposed machine-learning approach applies to both solid and liquid high-entropy alloys.
The proposed approach is applicable at high temperatures.
The proposed approach is applicable across varied high-entropy-alloy compositions.
Machine learning can efficiently predict phase stability in high-entropy alloys.
Machine learning can efficiently predict the thermodynamic properties needed to characterize the solid-to-fluid transition.
Machine-learning predictions enable identification of optimal high-entropy-alloy compositions.
Machine-learning predictions enable identification of optimal processing conditions.
The intervention will improve determination of transition temperature relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will improve determination of fusion enthalpy relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will improve determination of fusion entropy relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will improve determination of volume change at the transition relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will improve determination of dense-fluid heat capacity relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The applicability of the intervention is limited to high-entropy alloys and their applications.
The accuracy of machine-learning predictions for high-entropy-alloy phase stability and thermodynamic properties is uncertain.
